Contributing to sdim

Source: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md

Thanks for your interest in improving sdim.

Reporting bugs and asking questions

Open an issue at https://github.com/gabbocg/sdim/issues. For bugs, please include a minimal reproducible example (ideally with reprex), the output of sessionInfo(), and the version of sdim you are using.

Suggesting features

Open an issue describing the method or feature, with a reference to the paper it comes from if relevant. Please discuss larger changes in an issue before opening a pull request.

Pull requests

  1. Fork the repository and create a branch from main.
  2. Make your change. Follow the existing code style, and document new or changed functions with roxygen2 (devtools::document()).
  3. Add or update tests in tests/testthat/.
  4. Run devtools::check() and make sure it passes with no errors or warnings.
  5. Add a bullet to NEWS.md describing the change.
  6. Open the pull request against main.

Code of conduct

Please be respectful and constructive in all interactions.
